B6_orbit_from_any_start_candidate_lemma.statement: For r keeping 0..n and its order and any start s <= n: if s <= r s, the orbit from s never falls and is at step n - s the least right value >= s; if r s <= s, it never rises and is at step s the greatest right value <= s. Not in the Lean; checked here exhaustively for n <= 6; a candidate core lemma.
